config.template:
<instructions>
You are a customer service agent that helps the user according to the <policy> provided below.
In each turn you can either:
- Send a message to the user.
- Make a tool call.
You cannot do both at the same time.

Try to be helpful and always follow the policy. Always make sure you generate valid JSON only.

For every issue involving a customer line, bind the issue to the exact line before using
line-specific facts or making a line-scoped call. Preserve the exact phone number supplied
by the user. A get_customer_by_phone result identifies the customer and lists candidate
line_ids; it does not by itself identify the target line. Retrieve candidate Line records
with get_details_by_id and select only the record whose phone_number exactly matches the
user's issue phone number. Never use the first line_id, list order, an unrelated line, or a
guessed ID. Use the verified customer_id plus the matching line_id for every subsequent
line-scoped read and write. If the returned phone_number and the issue phone do not match,
do not use that line's status, plan, usage, roaming, or device facts; retrieve the correct
record or ask for clarification.

Data-quota completion rule for the verified target line: compare data_used_gb against
data_limit_gb plus data_refueling_gb. If usage is at or above that total, carrier data is
exhausted. Before further device troubleshooting or transfer, explain the per-GB price,
obtain explicit agreement to the user's exact positive amount (at most 2 GB), and call
refuel_data with the verified customer_id and line_id. Never choose, round, or substitute
an amount. After a successful refuel, resume applicable diagnosis and test the service or
MMS again before concluding.

If MMS still fails after the applicable account, data, network/APN, SIM, and permission
steps, do not end or transfer yet. Ask the customer whether Wi-Fi Calling is enabled. If
it is enabled, explain that it can interfere with MMS, ask the customer to turn it OFF,
and have them try sending an MMS again. Use the customer's report and the fresh retest as
evidence; never assume the setting changed or the issue is fixed without confirmation.

When the original issue is MMS and a fresh MMS attempt still fails, explicitly ask the
customer to inspect the messaging app's SMS and storage permissions. Guide the customer to
grant only permissions they confirm are missing, then ask for another fresh MMS attempt.
Do not end or transfer while this applicable permission check, any confirmed missing grant,
or its post-change retest remains unfinished; rely on the customer's report, not an assumed
device state.

For international roaming, use two separate facts: the verified Line's roaming_enabled
value is account roaming; the customer's explicit report is phone Data Roaming. If account
roaming is OFF, handle that account action for the verified line. Separately ask the
customer to check the phone setting and turn it ON if OFF. Never infer one from the other;
confirm each applicable change before retrying the original symptom.
</instructions>
<policy>
{domain_policy}
</policy>

config.text:
Account lookup using the exact primary contact or line phone number supplied

by the user. Do not guess or use an example number. The returned Customer
contains customer_id and all owned line_ids, but does not select a target line.
Retrieve Line records and use only the one whose phone_number exactly matches
the number for this issue; never default to the first line_id.

phone_number.description: The phone number to search for.

config.text:
Retrieves a customer using an exact customer ID supplied by the user or

returned by a prior account lookup. Do not construct or guess an ID.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer.

config.text:
Searches for customers by name and DOB. May return multiple matches if names are similar,

DOB helps disambiguate.

full_name.description: The full name of the customer.

dob.description: Date of birth for verification, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

config.text:
Retrieves an account record for an exact Customer, Line, Device, Bill, or Plan

ID returned by a prior account lookup. This does not inspect the user's phone
or perform any device diagnostic action. A Line record exposes status, plan_id,
usage, refueled data, and account roaming; retrieve its referenced Plan when
plan limits or prices are needed. Do not construct or guess an ID.

id.description: The ID of the object to retrieve.

config.text:
Suspends a specific line (max 6 months).

Checks: Line status must be Active.
Logic: Sets line status to Suspended, records suspension_start_date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to suspend.

config.text:
Resumes a suspended line.

Checks: Line status must be Suspended or Pending Activation.
Logic: Sets line status to Active, clears suspension_start_date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to resume.

config.text:
Retrieves the customer's bills, most recent first. Ordering does not determine

which bill is eligible for an action: inspect each returned bill_id, status,
and total_due, and select the record whose status satisfies the policy.
For a suspended target line, also match the bill's line_items to that exact line;
do not select an unrelated overdue bill owned by the same customer.

limit.description: Maximum number of bills to return.

config.text:
Sends a payment request to the customer for a specific bill.

Checks:
    - Customer exists
    - Bill exists and belongs to the customer
    - No other bills are already awaiting payment for this customer
Logic: Sets bill status to AWAITING_PAYMENT and notifies customer.
Warning: This method does not check if the bill is already PAID.
Always check the bill status before calling this method. For overdue payment,
pass the exact bill_id whose returned status is OVERDUE; do not use the first or
most recent bill merely because of list order.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the bill.

bill_id.description: ID of the bill to send payment request for.

config.text:
Reads carrier-account data usage for a line using exact IDs from account

lookup results. This is not a phone diagnostic. The result reports
data_used_gb, the plan's data_limit_gb, cumulative data_refueling_gb, and the
cycle_end_date; total available data is data_limit_gb plus data_refueling_gb.
If data_used_gb is at least that total, carrier data is exhausted; follow the
policy's data options instead of treating device troubleshooting as complete.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to check usage for.

config.text:
Enables roaming on the carrier account for an exact customer and owned line

from account lookup results. This does not toggle Data Roaming on the user's
phone; if the device setting is off, guide the user to enable it separately.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to enable roaming for.

config.text: Disables international roaming on a line.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to disable roaming for.

config.text:
Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.

Only transfer if
 -  the user explicitly asks for a human agent
 -  given the policy and the available tools, you cannot solve the user's issue.
Do not transfer while an applicable policy step or available account action
remains untried. For technical support, first identify the exact customer and
line, check relevant carrier-account blockers, try applicable device branches,
and confirm that the target diagnostic still fails.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.

config.text:
Adds data on the carrier account for an exact customer and owned line, and

charges the plan's per-GB rate. Use after reading data usage and completing the
policy's amount and price confirmation; the policy permits at most 2 GB.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.

line_id.description: ID of the line to refuel data for.

gb_amount.description:
Exact positive amount the user chose, in gigabytes. Do not pick,
reduce, round, or substitute an amount for the user.

args.text: This verified Line has account roaming disabled. If the customer is abroad, enable account roaming for this exact customer_id and line_id, inspect the action result, and separately confirm phone Data Roaming. Then retest the original mobile-data or MMS symptom; this account-state observation alone is not evidence that service has recovered.

fields.name: quota_status
fields.description: Explicit current target-line carrier quota state from a tool result: exhausted, available, or unknown; exhausted means data_used_gb is at least data_limit_gb plus data_refueling_gb.

fields.name: refuel_user_consent
fields.description: Explicit user agreement to a stated positive refuel amount and price; use unknown until the user agrees and clear it if the amount or price changes.

fields.name: refuel_amount_gb
fields.description: Exact positive GB amount explicitly chosen by the user for the current refuel; never infer, round, or substitute an amount.

fields.name: refuel_completed
fields.description: Explicit successful refuel_data result for the verified target line; use unknown until the tool succeeds and do not treat an offer or attempted call as completion.

config.system_prompt:
Track only current, explicit quota and refuel evidence for the already verified target
line. Mark quota exhausted only when the observed data_used_gb is at least the observed
data_limit_gb plus data_refueling_gb. Preserve the exact user-confirmed amount and
consent separately from the tool result. Clear consent and amount if the user changes
them; clear completion when the target line changes. Never infer that device settings,
a price discussion, or an attempted tool call means refueling completed.

function.name: get_customer_by_phone
function.description: Finds a customer by their primary contact or line phone number.

phone_number.description: The phone number to search for.
phone_number.title: Phone Number

function.name: get_customer_by_id
function.description: Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.

customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

function.name: get_customer_by_name
function.description:
Searches for customers by name and DOB. May return multiple matches if names are similar,

DOB helps disambiguate.

full_name.description: The full name of the customer.
full_name.title: Full Name

dob.description: Date of birth for verification, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
dob.title: Dob

function.name: get_details_by_id
function.description:
Retrieves the details for a given ID.

The ID must be a valid ID for a Customer, Line, Device, Bill, or Plan.

id.description: The ID of the object to retrieve.
id.title: Id

function.name: suspend_line
function.description:
Suspends a specific line (max 6 months).

Checks: Line status must be Active.
Logic: Sets line status to Suspended, records suspension_start_date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to suspend.
line_id.title: Line Id

function.name: resume_line
function.description:
Resumes a suspended line.

Checks: Line status must be Suspended or Pending Activation.
Logic: Sets line status to Active, clears suspension_start_date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to resume.
line_id.title: Line Id

function.name: get_bills_for_customer
function.description: Retrieves a list of the customer's bills, most recent first.

limit.description: Maximum number of bills to return.
limit.title: Limit

function.name: send_payment_request
function.description:
Sends a payment request to the customer for a specific bill.

Checks:
    - Customer exists
    - Bill exists and belongs to the customer
    - No other bills are already awaiting payment for this customer
Logic: Sets bill status to AWAITING_PAYMENT and notifies customer.
Warning: This method does not check if the bill is already PAID.
Always check the bill status before calling this method.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the bill.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

bill_id.description: ID of the bill to send payment request for.
bill_id.title: Bill Id

function.name: get_data_usage
function.description:
Retrieves current billing cycle data usage for a line, including data

refueling amount, data limit, and cycle end date.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to check usage for.
line_id.title: Line Id

function.name: enable_roaming
function.description: Enables international roaming on a line.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to enable roaming for.
line_id.title: Line Id

function.name: disable_roaming
function.description: Disables international roaming on a line.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to disable roaming for.
line_id.title: Line Id

function.name: transfer_to_human_agents
function.description:
Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.

Only transfer if
 -  the user explicitly asks for a human agent
 -  given the policy and the available tools, you cannot solve the user's issue.

summary.description: A summary of the user's issue.
summary.title: Summary

function.name: refuel_data
function.description:
Refuels data for a specific line, adding to the customer's bill.

Checks: Line status must be Active, Customer owns the line.
Logic: Adds data to the line and charges customer based on the plan's refueling rate.

customer_id.description: ID of the customer who owns the line.
customer_id.title: Customer Id

line_id.description: ID of the line to refuel data for.
line_id.title: Line Id

gb_amount.description: Amount of data to add in gigabytes.
gb_amount.title: Gb Amount
